verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's own Patents page describes patent litigation with named courts and outcomes. It cites UK Supreme Court cases including Unwired Planet, direct experience in Unified Patent Court proceedings, and a Court of Appeal win for Optis that raised the sum due from Apple to $502 million. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of these outcomes, and court or venue detail for trademark or trade-secret disputes (the brands page mentions enforcement only in general terms).

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages

citations.quote: We have acted on many of the most significant patent cases in the UK and across Europe over the last 20 years, including multiple cases before the UK Supreme Court such as the seminal FRAND dispute Unwired Planet.
As well as litigating UK proceedings, we advise on and coordinate pan-European strategy and have direct experience acting in proceedings before the Unified Patent Court.
We secured a significant win at the Court of Appeal resulting in an increased sum of $502 million due to Optis from Apple.
